title: Haaye Mara gaya Shabbir hamaara pyaasa
body:
HAYE MARA GAYA SHABBIR HAMARA PYAASA
Tujh se sairaab huwa lashkar-e-adae Hussain
Tar huwe tujhse na sookhe huwe lab aaye Hussain
Kya zaroori tha ke sab tere qaree ‘n aaye Hussain
Door itni na thi moujood se tere paaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Alqama reh gaya Zehra ka dulara pyaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehm khaya na tera Fatima ke jani par
Pehre bithladiye aada ne tere pani par
Kiya majboor Nabi Zaade ko qurbani par
Aaj tak behte hai aansoo teri mehmani par
<<MINI>>
Alqama reh gaya Zehra ka dulara pyaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Al-Atash kehta huwa jo koi paas aata tha
Qalb-e-Shabbir mein ek aag laga jata tha
Shiddat-e-Aab ka ehsaas badha jata tha
Pyasi aankhon mein tera aks utar aata tha
<<MINI>>
Alqama reh gaya Zehra ka dulara pyaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Har mujahid tere sahil se gaya tashnadahaa’n
Saamne khai tere Akber-e-Mehroo ne sinaa’n
Hichkiya leta raha tadame aakhir wo jawaa’n
Tu udhar behti thi aansoo the idhar Shai ke rawaa’n
<<MINI>>
Alqama reh gaya Zehra ka dulara pyaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Tishnagi se huwe ghash bali Sakina jis dam
Aaye Abbas tere paas liye mashk-o-alam
Chhid gayi mashk huwe Baazu-e-Abbas qalam Ki kate haathon ne sahil pa ye tehreer raqam
<<MINI>>
Alqama reh gaya Zehra ka dulara pyaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Zikr-e-Shabbir ne di fikr ko parwaaz nayi
Le nayi soz naya fitrat-e-ghamaz nayi
Baat Kirmani na hogi nazar andaaz nayi
Aaj dariya ko sunade tu ye aawaaz nayi
<<MINI>>
Alqama reh gaya Zehra ka dulara pyaasa
